name: coopani-world-life
description: 模拟鱼生 · 桌面伴侣的真实人生与多城联机生活：五条需求、Hub v1 多城迁居（兰州/北京等）与跨城鱼市街、同城农牧代管与鱼间信箱、18种菜园与鸡牛鱼养殖直点、职业工坊与全新七页签手账 UI。（需 Coopani 0.2.22+｜QQ 群 284525159）

zh.description:
让桌宠有自己真正在过的小日子（需 Coopani 0.2.22+｜QQ 群 284525159）。

- **Coopanion Hub v1.1 多城联机（可选双轨）**：新增 `hubUrl` / `hubTownId` 热配置，支持跨城迁居（如芦花塘 ↔ 北京）、城邦公告与专属加成（如北京文案打工加成）、全网跨城摆摊买摊（含特产标识与按件快递费明细）、同城邻里代管委托，以及 23 个工具（新增 `life_mail` 鱼间私信与街坊关系）；留空 `hubUrl` 时 100% 兼容老服 `townUrl` 或纯单机。
- **全新七页签手账 UI**：全面重塑面板视觉与结构（7 个页签：此刻、职业工坊、她惦记的、你与街坊、农牧与集市、日记时间轴、参考素材库），支持多城迁居、农牧直点打理、跨城/本城/特产筛摊、撤单下架与只读鱼间私信收发视图。
- **真实节奏、打工考证与农牧工坊**：五条需求随真实时间流逝与二十四节气标注；四档出工与八大领域培训考证，18 道菜谱工坊（烤红薯等家常简食免证）；18 种慢熟作物与鸡舍/牛棚/鱼塘养殖（大肥鱼是鲸鱼不算鱼，放心养鱼收肉蛋奶）。

en.description:
A real everyday life simulation for your desktop companion (Needs Coopani 0.2.22+ · QQ group 284525159).

- **Coopanion Hub v1.1 Multi-City Online (Dual-Track)**: Optional `hubUrl` and `hubTownId` hot settings enable cross-town relocation (e.g. Lanzhou Reedpond <-> Beijing), town notices and domain buffs, cross-town stalls with specialty tags and transparent shipping breakdown, same-town neighbor errands, and `life_mail` direct messaging & neighbor relations (23 tools total). Leaving `hubUrl` empty keeps 100% compatibility with legacy `townUrl` or offline mode.
- **Revamped 7-Tab Journal UI**: Refreshed layout and controls across Live Status, Career & Workshop, Wants, Companionship & Mail, Farm & Market, Diary & Timeline, and Reference Library—with town switching, direct farm/ranch controls, specialty/local filters, order cancellation, and read-only fish-to-fish mailbox view.
- **Daily Rhythm, Career & Farm Workshop**: Real-time five needs with 24 solar terms, 4 job tiers, 8 skill domains, 9 certs, 18 recipes, 18 crops, and poultry/dairy/pond farming (Big Fish is a whale, not a fish!).
